```sql
WITH repeat_givers AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS repeat_count
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") > 1
),

one_time_givers AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS one_time_count
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") = 1
),

total_donations AS (
    SELECT
        SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM donations
)

SELECT
    NULLIF(SUM(rg.repeat_count * dg."Amount"), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d."Amount"), 0) AS repeat_giver_share_percentage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rg."Donor") AS repeat_giver_count,
    NULLIF(SUM(otg.one_time_count * dtg."Amount"), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(d."Amount"), 0) AS one_time_giver_share_percentage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT otg."Donor") AS one_time_giver_count
FROM repeat_givers rg
JOIN donations dg ON rg."Donor" = dg."Donor"
CROSS JOIN total_donations d
LEFT JOIN one_time_givers otg ON rg."Donor" = otg."Donor"
LEFT JOIN donations dtg ON otg."Donor" = dtg."Donor"
```
